title: The Sapphire project and Hal Puthoff

tellings.quote: like the Sapphire project and things like this popped up for a bit like you know, we're balling the stars. We're doing it. Gone.

plain: Something called the Sapphire project, tied to the physicist Hal Puthoff, appeared briefly with big promises about reaching the stars and then disappeared. Jay Anderson mentions it in passing without naming a source, as an example of bold projects that show up and vanish.
